items.title: Battery Sim thermal model is 50x slower than the pack it now models
items.notes: user 2026-09-23: temperature frozen at 20.0 and ambient has no effect. Both real: C=1/A_THERMAL=5000 J/degC and KE=1.6 W/degC give tau=52 min (0.10 degC/min idle, 0.38 degC/min across a 20 degC ambient gap) while Q_MAX_AH=25 moves SOC in seconds. Staged A_THERMAL=0.001 + KE=8.0 -> tau 2.1 min. Initial temperature is A_THERMAL*100000, so the plant must decouple it first or the sim boots at the 60 degC clamp
